summary: Adversarial independent code review of f-v4-note-search on E1488 (deployed build a579a38). Owner-scoping is structural: ListNotes(session.UserID) runs before the q filter, so a query can only narrow. Auth precedes method/id/body handling (401 + WWW-Authenticate, no side effects). Query semantics: trim, empty/whitespace no-op, case-insensitive, [] not null, UserID never serialized. DELETE strict-parsed with slice removal and repeat-404. UI funnels load/create/delete/reload through one renderNotes() and clears stale notebook.search. go build/vet/test and 18/18 targeted tests green. No confirmed critical/high findings; only low/info hygiene items.

findings.title: Whitespace-only q longer than 512 bytes returns 400 'query too long' instead of all notes (INV-SEARCH-EMPTY-Q)
findings.evidence: len(rawQuery) > maxQueryBytes checked before strings.TrimSpace; API-consumer-only (web UI filters client-side).

findings.title: 512-byte q cap / 400 'query too long' missing from spec/contract docs
findings.evidence: Contract table and spec/core.md lack the q>512 row; cap only in code comment, test, and followup docs.

findings.title: SEARCH-E2E-7/8 have no traceability entries in scenarios.json / scenario-evidence.json
findings.evidence: Spec defines 8 tests; scenarios.json/scenario-evidence.json evidence only 1..6; header comment still says 1..6.

findings.title: Dead CSS rule .notes-search-empty (no element carries the class)
findings.evidence: index.html renders data-testid=notes-search-empty with class=muted; rule matches nothing. Cosmetic.

findings.title: Adversarial probe: q may widen results beyond owner's notes
findings.evidence: REFUTED: ListNotes(session.UserID) first, q filter narrows only. TestNotesSearchIsolation/TestNotesIsolation pass.

findings.title: Adversarial probe: method/id/body handling before auth
findings.evidence: REFUTED: requireAuth first in handleNotes/handleNoteItem; unauth -> 401 + WWW-Authenticate, no side effects.

findings.title: Adversarial probe: data race or injection in the search path
findings.evidence: REFUTED by inspection: ListNotes copies under s.mu; matching is strings.Contains only; no SQL/regex/eval. -race not runnable (no gcc/cgo).
